answer: The second‑most powerful earthquake ever recorded was the **Great Alaska earthquake of 1964** (magnitude ≈ 9.2–9.3). It caused **139 deaths** in total—15 directly from the shaking and 124 from the ensuing tsunami and secondary effects.
